facts.premium: EEC-linked industrial province; factory pay above national amid rural surroundings
anchors: Industrial estates — 990 factories, ~111k factory workers (304 Industrial Park, Rojana)
impacts: Electronics/auto-parts jobs anchor formal wages but face EV-transition and export risk
Cassava down ~20-25% YoY squeezes a major farm income source
Cane up ~26% YoY supports planter incomes this season
Top-tier wage lifts factory take-home but accelerates automation
Cassava and cane yields exposed to rainfall variability
290k vehicles, 59% motorbikes, 17% pickups — mixed factory/farm collateral base
